question: Is the final head's compatibility and delivery proof sufficient to make account-specific apiMode resolution, receive-readiness probing, and setup cancellation authoritative for existing Signal installations and plugin setup flows?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and well tested, but it changes upgrade-sensitive configuration, message routing, probing, and a shared plugin API; accepting those behavioral changes requires maintainer ownership and exact-head proof rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Re-prove the final head
options.body: Run exact-head upgrade and live Signal setup/send/receive proof, then merge if existing top-level and mixed-account configurations remain compatible.

options.title: Accept prior-head evidence
options.body: Merge based on the extensive earlier-head tests and reviews while explicitly owning the residual risk from later force-pushed changes.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Split the shared cancellation contract or broad transport-routing changes from the Signal wizard if exact-head compatibility cannot be established promptly.

recommendation.title: Re-prove the final head
recommendation.body: Run exact-head upgrade and live Signal setup/send/receive proof, then merge if existing top-level and mixed-account configurations remain compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned member and current owner of the implementation and its accumulated validation context.
